title: Finish Unit-Time Tasks with Prerequisites
prompt: Implement `solution(n, deps)`. Tasks are labeled `1` through `n`; each takes exactly one time unit. A pair `(a, b)` means task `a` must finish before `b` starts. Any number of ready tasks can run in parallel. Return the minimum number of time units needed to complete all tasks, or `-1` if a dependency cycle prevents completion. Return `0` for `n == 0`. Assume task IDs in `deps` are valid. Explain the algorithm and its time and space costs.

example.reasoning: Tasks 1 and 2 run together, then task 3 runs.
